guest_wilds.configuration.title: Guest Wilds
guest_wilds.configuration.paths.tooltip: Walking entities and unobserved traffic trample grass into paths that regrow when unused.
guest_wilds.configuration.wearMultiplier: Scales how quickly routes turn into paths.
guest_wilds.configuration.lairs.tooltip: Caves hold persistent hostile populations that grow, compete and migrate.
guest_wilds.configuration.suppressSurfac: Zombies, skeletons, spiders and creepers under the open sky come from lairs instead of random spawning. Spawners and structures are unaffected.
guest_wilds.configuration.suppressRandom: Skeleton riders only appear from long-established mixed spider and skeleton lairs.
guest_wilds.configuration.undeadDailyCyc: Undead leave their lairs at dusk and seek cover before dawn instead of burning.
guest_wilds.configuration.fogShieldsUnde: Undead do not burn in fog and can hunt during a foggy day.
guest_wilds.configuration.herds.tooltip: Wild animals belong to herds that graze, migrate and change in number while unobserved.
guest_wilds.configuration.herdRelocation: Animals left behind by a migrating herd rejoin it when their area loads again.
guest_wilds.configuration.grazersEatGras: Cows and goats eat grass like sheep do.
guest_wilds.configuration.weatherShelter: Animals seek cover in rain and blizzards; spiders and creepers retreat during severe storms.
guest_wilds.configuration.seasonalVarian: Husks, strays, bogged, winter coats and chicken variants follow place and season.
guest_wilds.configuration.fishShoals.too: Fishing depends on local shoals that deplete and regrow; large shoals give several fish per cast.
guest_wilds.configuration.endermenPlaces: Overworld endermen gather near strongholds, ancient cities, ruined portals and other ancient structures.
guest_wilds.configuration.endermenElsewh: Share of enderman spawns still allowed away from places of power.
guest_wilds.command.overworld_only: Guest Wilds only simulates the Overworld.
guest_wilds.command.herd: Herd of %s: %s animals (%s seen) grazing at %s, vegetation %s.
guest_wilds.command.shoal.none: Stand in water to inspect its shoal.
guest_wilds.command.shoal: %s shoal: %s of %s fish, salmon share %s, %s visible.
guest_wilds.command.simulate: Advanced %s days and caught the wilds up.
